Tuyến đường sắt Hà Nội Hải Phòng hiện na.en: The current Han Sea Hall Railway is mainly for student service, laborer and tourist tours who want to experience railroads while traveling to Sea Hall. Along with it was the freight service to the railway stations from Hanoi to the Customs and vice versa.
